negative_reviews.author: SMILE DAY
negative_reviews.text:
Very disappointed with my experience.

The curry chicken was far too salty, and the chicken portions were very small despite the high price. On top of that, the restaurant automatically added a 10% service charge, which made the meal even more expensive.

The ramen was also extremely oily and not enjoyable at all.

Overall, the food was overpriced and not worth the money. I won't be coming back.

negative_reviews.author: Docile Bodies
negative_reviews.text: Eating food at this place was equal to being dismembered on a medieval market square during a nice summer’s night. An insult to the history of food. Staff was quite nice! Please reconsider the use of that big drum when people enter the restaurant
